pages.text: $(l)1. Pipe and base$()$(br)Build the industrial pipe column from the deposit up to the surface (see the previous chapter), then place the $(item)Pumpjack Base$() directly on top of the last pipe.

$(l)2. Holder$()$(br)Place the $(item)Hammer Holder$() a few blocks away from the base, in line with it. Its facing comes from the direction you look when placing it, and that facing sets the $(item)axis of the beam$(): the beam must run along it, east-west or north-south.

$(l)3. Beam$()$(br)On the block right above the holder, lay $(item)hammer parts$() in a straight line along that axis. Put the $(item)head$() at the end above the base and the $(item)connector$() at the other end. Parts, head and connector placed while you look along the beam all end up on the right axis.

$(l)4. Glue$()$(br)Use $(item)Super Glue$() over the whole beam, from head to connector. The beam moves as one contraption, and unglued blocks are left behind.$(br2)$(l)5. Drive$()$(br)Put the $(item)crank$() under the connector and a $(item)Machine Input$() right under the crank.
The items this page talks about. Hover for details; JEI shows their recipes.
